The front-left die has front face 1 and right face 4, so its back face is opposite the front face and is 6, so the front face of the back-left die is 6. The back-right die has front face 5 and right face 4, so its left face is opposite the right face and is 3, so the right face of the back-left die is 3. Now the back-left die needs to satisfy front face 6 and right face 3. In the same labeling scheme as the reference die, when the top face 6 of the reference die is turned to the front and the right face 3 remains on the right side, the original back face 5 turns to the top face. Therefore the top face where the question mark is located is 5.
